item.title: Why Malaysia’s Health Care Financing Model Is Mathematically Unsustainable
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysia’s health financing model is fundamentally unsustainable because most Malaysians don't pay income tax. This is also the reason why a mandatory NHI scheme isn't feasible. MediAsas is also just a mirage because it's just private health insurance. The post Why Malaysia’s Health Care Financing Model Is Mathematically Unsustainable appeared first on CodeBlue .
